# Thiago Albuquerque de Paula

> Full-stack developer in Brasília (DF), Brazil. Builds mission-critical systems at work and purpose-driven products of his own. Site: https://thiago.catiteo.com/

Thiago Albuquerque de Paula is a full-stack developer based in Brasília. He works on large corporate applications and APIs in high-criticality environments (Java, Quarkus, Spring, Angular) and ships his own products end to end. Faith and family sit at the center of how he chooses what to build.
